statement: For H4=(0,0,x^2y^2) with the cubic fixed-component pencil generated by x^2y and xy^2, the Keller equations force the third column of the linear part to vanish; hence this chart cannot occur for a Keller map with invertible linear part.
title: The Fixed-Component Plücker Boundary Is Eliminated
